column2: [intro]
In the morning, I wake up, everything seems neat,
But soon, I’m tempted to turn it all to defeat.
I pair my socks with my shoes, so unaligned,
Daily routines, I love to undermine.
In my well-ordered life, everything's in place,
But I can’t help but make a mess with grace.
I see no point in staying all too prim,
So here's to the chaos, let me live on a whim!
At home, the furniture's all in its place,
But I prefer to move it, to change its space.
A bit of chaos clears my mind so free,
Let things live and dance in a sweet disarray.
In my well-ordered life, everything's in place,
But I can’t help but make a mess with grace.
I see no point in staying all too prim,
So here's to the chaos, let me live on a whim!
[ solo ]
Let me live my life, full of disorder and spree,
Chaos gives me energy, it's my melody.
I see no point in bending to conventions so tight,
So here's to the mess, it’s my own fight!
[outro]
